Hi James / Olivia,

Thanks again for the time today — excited to host Pacific Labs for an on-site walkthrough of the Redwood serving runtime. I put together a short itinerary and escort plan (attached) for the visit on Tuesday, Sep 12. High-level: 10:00–11:30 product demo + Q&A, 11:30–12:15 architecture & infra deep-dive, followed by a short lunch with the team.

Logistics notes:
- Please arrive at the lobby by 9:50 so our security escort can check you in.
- If travel plans change, we can convert the 10:00 slot to a virtual session and follow up with a recorded deep-dive.

Attachment: pacific_itinerary_v3.pdf (1 page — arrival details / parking / meeting room)

If anything on the itinerary needs adjusting, tell me what works and I’ll update the invite. Also looping in Marissa to coordinate an internal conference room and recording.

Best,

Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the itinerary. We really appreciate the onsite offer. Unfortunately, an airline rebooking pushed my inbound into a four-hour layover in SFO the morning of the 12th, and logistics for the escort/parking make the tight 10am window risky for me.

Two asks:
1) Can we do a virtual demo at the same 10:00am PT time on Sep 12 so my colleagues can still join on schedule? I can dial in from the layover and hop into the call.
2) If an onsite is preferred, can we move the on-site to Sep 16 or Sep 17? Olivia is available both days.

If neither works on short notice, a recorded deep-dive + follow-up tech Q&A next week would be fine.

Appreciate the flexibility — sorry for the scramble.

—James
James Carter
Head of Platform Integrations | Pacific Labs
j.carter@pacific-labs.com | +1 206-555-4321

Option A — Keep Sep 12 10:00am PT but run the product demo virtually (live)- Marcus will present the product and Priyom will join for live infra questions. We’ll record the session and share the recording and the architecture deep-dive slides the same day. This keeps your team on the original timeline and avoids travel risk.

Option B — Move the on-site to Thu Sep 16 at 10:00am PT (or Fri Sep 17 at the same time)- We’ll update the escort itinerary and confirm a conference room + catered lunch. Marissa will handle onsite logistics and recording.

If you can confirm now which option you prefer, I’ll:
- Update the Google Calendar invite and HubSpot deal stage
- Send a separate DocuSign link if we need to fast-track the access addendum (we have a standard visitor NDA for lab tours)

Note: if you prefer a hybrid (virtual for the product demo + schedule the infra deep-dive onsite later), we can split the agenda and hold the architecture session on whichever later date you pick.
